## Checks
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `dart format`, `dart analyze` and `flutter analyze` are clean
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `flutter test --exclude-tags golden` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line if a user would notice
- [ ] No animation added; UI text is English
- [ ] No secrets, signing keys or personal data
